title: Overthinking isn't you caring too much 🛡️ #shorts
description:
"What if this… what if that…" Research suggests worry may work like a shield: it keeps you busy talking about the danger so you never fully feel the fear underneath. It isn't proof you care too much. 🛡️ Send this to the friend who calls it "just planning".

Watch the full video: https://youtu.be/ez-lXPY79pU
